versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Knights only work when no other Knight stands next to them, so at most three hold stations with open ground between.
You choose each turn whether to leave that ground empty for lone giants or fill it with hens and other tribes' units that the Knights feed on; heirs wake mid-fight when an elder falls.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Every card now shows whether it is a Knight, Watcher or Squire, Squires ignore each other, and Bristlebeard and Roost-Pine Squire say exactly what they gain.
All three reviewers said the rule couldn't be read off the cards; Pennon-Bearer also now rewards standing next to the Gallery, since all three called it a plain buff.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
